tea-rice.purpose: Page background and the inside of text boxes (light).

surface.purpose: Cards, compartments, top bar, buttons, menus, sheets (light).

soy-ink.purpose: Body text; fill of a chosen filter chip and of toasts (light).

quiet-grey.purpose: Everything quiet: hints, placeholders, unchosen, done (light).

border-mist.purpose: 1 px borders and an off switch's track (light).

umeboshi.purpose: Doing: buttons, links, the selected thing, focus rings (light).

umeboshi-soft.purpose: Hover wash, step numbers, inline tips, update banner (light).

jade-soft.purpose: Tags, the active tab, plan dishes, active toolbar filter (light).

jade-strong.purpose: Jade text and solid fills: success, switch on, ticks, selected tag (light).

jade-leaf.purpose: The title's leaf and baran: shapes only, never text.

rim.purpose: A bento tray's rim and the tab bar (light).

rim-text.purpose: Words written on a tray's rim (light).

waribashi-wood.purpose: The chopstick underline and magnets, both themes. Never text.

pantry-low.purpose: A low pantry jar; also the gold of Quick (light).

heart.purpose: The favourite heart shape only (light; #f06595 dark).

rice-off.purpose: An empty onigiri rating's outline (light; #4a5653 dark).

danger-night.purpose: Errors (dark), pushed orange away from the pink accent.

themes.dark: Pond at night: the same tokens redefined in @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark). web/src/theme.ts rewrites those media rules to 'all' or 'not all' when someone picks Dark or Light in Settings, so every dark rule must live in such a block.

headline.purpose: Section headings the app writes, shelf and pantry place names on tray rims; Pond Pebbles. Dark mode adds a tight dark text-shadow outline.

title.purpose: Dialog and sheet headings (1.1rem in a sheet) and a recipe's own name; the phone's font.

label.purpose: Buttons, field labels, legends; 0.92rem on small buttons and chips.

hint.purpose: Hints under fields and the "?" tips.

shadows.name: dialog
shadows.purpose: The app's own "are you sure?" dialog, over a 45% black backdrop.

shadows.name: sheet
shadows.purpose: A panel sliding up from the bottom (the dinner chooser).

shadows.name: picker
shadows.purpose: Date and similar pickers over the page.

shadows.name: floating-bar
shadows.purpose: The step-timer tray above the tab bar; toasts use 0 4px 16px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.2).

shadows.name: dragged
shadows.purpose: A dish or shelf lifted while dragged.

shadows.name: small-lift
shadows.purpose: A small object resting on another: pick mark (also switch thumb 0 1px 2px / 0.3, heart over a photo 0 2px 8px / 0.25, brand note 0 2px 4px / 0.14, fridge notes 0 2px 6px / 0.12).

shadows.name: drop-ring
shadows.purpose: Where a dragged thing would land; a ring, not depth.

shadows.name: dark-heading-outline
shadows.purpose: Dark mode only: lets light Pond Pebbles headings stand off the rim.

motion.name: switch
motion.purpose: A toggle switch's track colour and thumb slide; a drawer's chevron turning.

motion.name: brand-note
motion.purpose: The brand's sticky note straightening under the pointer.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: With prefers-reduced-motion, every transition and animation is off.

sizing.tapArea: 44px minimum; an invisible ::before reaches --tap-x / --tap-y past smaller controls
sizing.textZoom: max(<px>, calc(<rem|em> * var(--text-zoom, 1))) for any size that holds text
sizing.rows: 36-38px list rows; 38px buttons; 36px small buttons and chips

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one main action in a row (Save, Add), last on the right. Umeboshi pill.

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: The default button: white pill with a thin border (Cancel, Keep editing).

components.name: Danger Button
components.description: Delete and the like: outlined in the danger colour, pushed to the left of a row.
components.css: .ds-btn-danger { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 38px; padding: 6px 14px; font: inherit; font-size: 0.9375rem; font-weight: 600; color: var(--danger, #b3261e); background: transparent; border: 1px solid var(--danger, #b3261e); border-radius: 999px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-danger:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--accent, #a82d4a); outline-offset: 1px; }

components.name: Filter Chips
components.description: Pill filters; the chosen one fills with ink. Tags are jade instead.
components.html: vegetarian
components.css: .ds-chips { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 8px; align-items: center; } .ds-chip { min-height: 36px; padding: 4px 14px; font: inherit; font-size: 0.92rem; color: var(--text, #2b2420); background: var(--surface, #fff); border: 1px solid var(--border, #d8dddb); border-radius: 999px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-chip[aria-pressed="true"] { color: var(--bg, #f3f6f4); background: var(--text, #2b2420); border-color: var(--text, #2b2420); } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--accent, #a82d4a); outline-offset: 1px; } .ds-tag { padding: 3px 10px; font-size: 0.85rem; color: var(--text, #2b2420); background: var(--jade-soft, #e2efeb); border-radius: 999px; }

components.name: Joined Search Box
components.description: A page's main box and its button as compartments of one tray; focus outlines the whole tray.
components.html: <form class="ds-joined" onsubmit="return false"><input class="ds-joined-input" placeholder="Add to the list" aria-label="Add to the list"><button class="ds-joined-btn">Add</button></form>

components.name: Tab Bar
components.description: The bottom tab bar as a tray: tabs as compartments, the current one jade with a plum label.
components.html: RecipesPlanShoppingPantry
components.css: .ds-tabbar { display: flex; gap: 4px; height: 60px; padding: 4px; background: var(--rim, #b9d6cd); } .ds-tab { flex: 1; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 2px; min-width: 0; font-size: 0.8rem; font-weight: 600; color: var(--muted, #5f6b67); text-decoration: none; background: var(--surface, #fff); border-radius: 8px; } .ds-tab:hover { color: var(--text, #2b2420); } .ds-tab-active, .ds-tab-active:hover { color: var(--accent, #a82d4a); background: var(--jade-soft, #e2efeb); } .ds-tab:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--accent, #a82d4a); outline-offset: -3px; }

components.name: Chopstick Switch
components.description: Two-way switch: the chosen side bold with a wooden chopstick under it, the other in quiet text.
components.css: .ds-switch { display: inline-flex; padding: 2px 4px; background: var(--surface, #fff); border: 1px solid var(--border, #d8dddb); border-radius: 12px; } .ds-switch button { position: relative; min-height: 32px; padding: 2px 12px 6px; font: inherit; font-size: 0.88rem; font-weight: 500; color: var(--muted, #5f6b67); background: none; border: none; border-radius: 8px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-switch button[aria-pressed="true"] { color: var(--text, #2b2420); font-weight: 700; } .ds-switch button[aria-pressed="true"]::after { content: ""; position: absolute; left: 10px; right: 10px; bottom: 3px; height: 4px; background: #a87a43; border-radius: 3px 2px 2px 3px; clip-path: polygon(0 0, 100% 25%, 100% 75%, 0 100%); } .ds-switch button:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--accent, #a82d4a); outline-offset: 1px; }

narrative.overview:
Everything is packed in its compartment. Things that belong together sit in a tray: a soft jade rim with rounded compartments inside, the chosen one filled. Umeboshi plum sits on tea-rice the way the pickled plum sits on rice, and it marks what you can do. A wooden chopstick (waribashi wood) underlines the chosen thing. Nothing floats loose: loose lines between trays and page titles start where a tray's compartments start, and buttons beside them line up with the trays' edges.

The feel is compact, homely and cheeky. Compact, not airy: 15 px text, about 8 px between things, list rows 36 to 38 px tall, so the whole shopping list or eight days of the plan fit on one screen. Homely: warm, lived-in materials (a jar for the pantry level, a brush stroke for a bought item, a round "Cooked" stamp, a fridge door with magnets) rather than generic app chrome. Cheeky in the corners only: Ben the screaming onigiri and the jokes live in empty screens, hints and small print, never on a button or in the way of the facts.

The surface is flat. Depth comes from tonal layering (white compartments on a jade rim on a tea-rice page), not from shadows. Shadows exist only on things that genuinely float over the page. The cream-and-terracotta palette people now read as AI-made is rejected outright; that is why the page is tea-rice and the accent is umeboshi. The phone's own font carries the reading; the drawn title, Ben and Pond Pebbles carry the personality. The art and Pond Pebbles were made with AI help and are never described as hand-drawn or hand-lettered.
keyCharacteristics: Bento trays: a jade rim (5 px) around white 8 px-rounded compartments, inside a 12 px-rounded tray.
Two accents with fixed jobs: umeboshi plum does things, jade labels things and brings good news.
Compact density with a 44 px tap area under every control.
Flat at rest; shadows only for floating layers.
Pond Pebbles for the titles and section headings the app writes; the phone's font for everything else.
Light "tea-rice" and dark "pond at night", with every contrast ratio kept the same.

rules.name: The Plum Does, Jade Tells Rule
rules.body: Umeboshi is for doing: buttons, links, the selected thing, focus. Jade is for labels and good news: tags, success, "have", switches that are on. Jade never fills a button.

rules.name: The Leaf Is Not Text Rule
rules.body: The plain jade leaf (#5a9a8a) is 3:1 on the background, so it draws shapes only. Jade words use Jade Strong.

rules.name: The Traffic Light Rule
rules.body: Have, Low and Out stay green, amber and red in both themes, whatever the palette around them does. They mean something at a glance.

rules.name: The Person Mix Rule
rules.body: A person's colour is never used raw. As text it is 65% the colour and 35% soy ink (`color-mix(in srgb, var(--person) 65%, var(--text))`), as a fill under white text 70% the colour and 30% black. Every person-coloured text or fill uses one of these two mixes.

rules.name: The Muted, Not Faded Rule
rules.body: Something quiet takes Quiet Grey, never opacity, so its words still read at 4.5:1. Opacity is for disabled controls, a thing being dragged, and soft decoration that carries no words.

rules.name: The Pebbles For What We Write Rule
rules.body: Pond Pebbles sets page titles and the section headings the app writes, nothing else: never buttons, body text, dialog titles, counts or badges beside a heading, or anything people type (a recipe's name stays in the phone's font).

rules.name: The No Eyebrow Rule
rules.body: No uppercase, letter-spaced labels or kickers above headings, and no dotted word lists. Taglines and labels are real sentences in sentence case. The only uppercase in the system is the lettering pressed into the round "Cooked" stamp.

rules.name: The Compact, Not Airy Rule
rules.body: New screens use the same 15 px text, 8 px rhythm and 36 to 38 px rows, not roomier defaults. More of the list on one screen is the point.

rules.name: The 44 To Tap Rule
rules.body: Every control is at least 44 by 44 px to tap, even when it is drawn smaller: an invisible `::before` reaches `--tap-x` / `--tap-y` past it, each reach at most half the gap to the next control. The look stays compact; the target never shrinks with it.

rules.name: The Text-Zoom Rule
rules.body: Android's web view enlarges font sizes but not rem or em in other lengths, so any size that holds text is written `max(<px>, calc(<rem or em> * var(--text-zoom, 1)))`. It looks the same in a browser and grows with the phone's biggest text.

rules.name: The Tray, Not Shadow Rule
rules.body: Grouping and hierarchy come from rims, compartments and tone. A card or tray never gets a shadow to stand out.

rules.name: The Floating Only Rule
rules.body: A drop shadow means the thing is above the page (a dialog, sheet, menu, bubble, toast, timer tray, or something being dragged) or a small object sitting on another. If it scrolls with the page and holds content, it is flat.

dos: **Do** group related things in a bento tray: Rim (#b9d6cd / #2c4a44) with 8 px-rounded Surface White compartments, heading on the rim, the chosen compartment filled.
**Do** use Umeboshi for anything you tap to act (buttons, links, the selected thing, the 3 px focus ring) and jade for labels, tags, "have" and good news.
**Do** keep 15 px body text, an 8 px rhythm and 36 to 38 px rows, with every control reaching 44 by 44 px to tap.
**Do** write sizes that hold text as `max(<px>, calc(<rem> * var(--text-zoom, 1)))`.
**Do** make quiet things Quiet Grey (#5f6b67 / #a9b3ae), never faded.
**Do** mix person colours toward Soy Ink for text (65%) and toward black for fills under white text (70%).
**Do** mark the chosen side of a two-way switch bold with the wooden chopstick underline.
**Do** put every dark-mode rule in a `@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark)` block, so the app's own Light / Dark choice (`web/src/theme.ts`) can switch it.
**Do** keep text contrast at least 4.5:1 (3:1 for large text) in both themes.
donts: **Don't** fill a button with jade, or set words in the plain jade leaf (#5a9a8a).
**Don't** give cards or trays a shadow; shadows are for dialogs, sheets, menus, bubbles, toasts, the timer tray and dragged things.
**Don't** put a tray inside a tray; buttons, text boxes, tips, pop-ups and the chopstick switches stay plain.
**Don't** use uppercase, letter-spaced eyebrow labels or dotted word lists.
**Don't** set buttons, body text, dialog titles or anything people type in Pond Pebbles.
**Don't** recolour Have / Low / Out away from green, amber and red.
**Don't** use opacity to make text quiet.
**Don't** drift back toward cream backgrounds with a terracotta accent.
**Don't** let a joke replace what a button or warning does.
**Don't** describe the title, Ben or Pond Pebbles as hand-drawn or hand-lettered.
